liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity rose by {{liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{liquidity@FY2025}}, of which {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} in undrawn committed facilities, broadly unchanged on the prior year, and cash and cash-like investments increased by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}.

Debt due within a year fell by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, so short-term debt cover improved by {{short_term_debt_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2025}}, and borrowings due within the following year of {{borrowings_due_2y@FY2025}} are covered {{liquidity_to_borrowings_due_2y@FY2025}} times by liquidity, so near-term maturities are met without new funding.

Free cash flow after lease payments fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, taking FCF after leases to debt down by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}}, a thin buffer once lease payments are charged against cash flow.

Customer prepayments remain a material part of the funding base: contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}, while advance ticket cover fell by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}.

watch_items.text: Cash flow after leases: FCF after leases to debt fell by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}}, so lease payments absorb most of the cash generated after capital spending.

Earnings: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}, with industrial action in the first half weighing on the result.

Leverage: gross leverage rose by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}, as EBITDA declined by {{ebitda.change@FY2025}}.
Costs: fuel makes up {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2025}} of costs, above the peer median of {{fuel_share_of_costs.peer_median@FY2025}}, and costs related to environmental regulation rose during the year.
